data.exact_reserve_text: The reserves established in 2020 have proved to be adequate and we have been able to make releases during 2021, especially on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, which are now reinsured under a Loss Portfolio Transfer arrangement.

An LPT has been put into place in December 2021 reinsuring the loss reserves on the 2018 and 2019 years of account... The reinsurance recovery included within the Net Technical Provisions as part of the LPT was GBP 28.0m.

data.standardized_narrative: Coverys Syndicate 1975 reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 9.539 million for the year ended 31 December 2021. This release represents an 11.68% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding. The releases were primarily driven by reserves established in 2020 for COVID-19 proving to be adequate, particularly impacting the 2018 and 2019 years of account. A Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) was also put in place in December 2021, reinsuring loss reserves on the 2018 and 2019 years of account to provide stability against future loss movements. The report does not provide a breakdown of the reserve movement by specific lines of business.
